deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.deferral_reason: Phase 1 vertical slice does not require occurrence records; relation and state paths suffice for capture-to-commitment.
deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.consumer_impact: Transformation and temporal profiles must not assume Occurrence records exist until KERNEL contract extends.

deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.deferral_reason: Perspective-scoped claims are modeled through branch_id + claimant + scope until a first-class Perspective record is justified.
deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.consumer_impact: Agent grounding program must treat claimant/branch as perspective proxy until explicit Perspective records ship.

deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.deferral_reason: Provenance closure and claim support are Phase 1 minimum; Evidence as a distinct kernel record is deferred.
deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.consumer_impact: Branch four-valued support must not require Evidence records until contract extension; use provenance + claim linkage.

deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.deferral_reason: Canonical type evolution is owned by metaphysical-vocabulary-governance; kernel uses opaque type_id references only.
deferred_first_class_kernel_concepts.consumer_impact: Vocabulary program must publish type registry contract before kernel type_id semantics expand beyond opaque reference.

obligations.source_quote: Every kernel record carries identity, type, provenance, scope linkage, version, and three independent lifecycle axes.
obligations.interpretation: KernelRecordEnvelope is mandatory on every kernel record; maturity, epistemic, and governance statuses are orthogonal literals.

obligations.source_quote: The envelope does not force a single branch_id on all records.
obligations.interpretation: Branch participation is expressed through BranchMembership and branch-bound record fields, not a universal envelope.branch_id.

obligations.source_quote: Twelve formal kernel concepts anchor the ontology.
obligations.interpretation: Phase 1 implements eight first-class record kinds plus profile objects; Occurrence, Perspective, Evidence defer; TypeDefinition defers to Vocabulary program.
obligations.unresolved_question: Which deferred concept ships in KERNEL-002 vs a later kernel tranche?

obligations.source_quote: Profiles compose kernel records but MUST NOT redefine kernel semantics.
obligations.interpretation: ProfileDefinition.forbidden_kernel_redefinitions and validate_profile_definition enforce separation.

obligations.source_quote: SourceFragment preserves input before interpretation.
obligations.interpretation: SourceFragment stores media_type, content_pointer, integrity_hash, and source_kind without collapsing into Claim or State.

obligations.source_quote: Referent distinguishes targets of reference.
obligations.interpretation: Referent carries canonical_label, aliases, and identity_policy_id placeholder; full IdentityPolicy record is not Phase 1.
obligations.unresolved_question: IdentityPolicy record shape and uncertain-identity relation tests are not yet specified (§5.13).

obligations.source_quote: Scope bounds conditions under which records hold.
obligations.interpretation: Scope includes modal_scope literal set and optional temporal/spatial/domain/task/context_refs fields.

obligations.source_quote: State is a modeled condition; it is not a Claim.
obligations.interpretation: State records require valid_scope_id and optional commitment_id; Claims cannot be adopted without StateCommitment.

obligations.source_quote: RelationInstance types relations among participants.
obligations.interpretation: RelationInstance requires type_id, participants with role/ref, and scope_id.

obligations.source_quote: Claim is truth-evaluable but not globally true by default.
obligations.interpretation: Claim requires branch_id, scope_id, claimant, proposition; validate_claim checks BranchMembership alignment.

obligations.source_quote: Every non-raw record has a derivation path.
obligations.interpretation: validate_provenance_closure ensures source_refs and derivation_steps terminate at sources or explicit creation.

obligations.source_quote: ModelBranch is an explicit interpretation branch.
obligations.interpretation: ModelBranch records branch_kind, parent linkage, assumptions, and merge_status without selecting global truth.
obligations.unresolved_question: Merge semantics and inheritance tables are owned by Branch program (BRANCH-001), not kernel runtime.

obligations.source_quote: BranchMembership states how a record participates in a branch.
obligations.interpretation: Membership links record_id, branch_id, membership_kind, effective_scope_id, and membership_provenance_id.

obligations.source_quote: StateCommitment is explicit Claim-to-State adoption.
obligations.interpretation: Adoption requires source_claim_ids, resulting_state_id, branch/scope alignment, responsible_actor, and commitment_provenance_id.

obligations.source_quote: Claims and States MUST NOT collapse.
obligations.interpretation: Validators and profile conformance reject claim_is_state and state_is_claim redefinitions.

obligations.source_quote: State adoption requires an explicit commitment.
obligations.interpretation: validate_state_adoption_links and runtime reject adoption without matching StateCommitment and BranchMembership.

obligations.source_quote: Profile conformance results are traceable outcomes.
obligations.interpretation: ProfileConformanceResult records evaluated_record_id, violations, and evaluated_at.

obligations.source_quote: Maturity, epistemic standing, and governance are independent axes.
obligations.interpretation: validate_lifecycle_independence rejects collapsed or equal-axis values except not_applicable epistemic case.

obligations.source_quote: Lifecycle transitions are governed, not implicit.
obligations.interpretation: Phase 1 validates literal sets only; transition policy and invalid-transition rejection are not yet a public operation.
obligations.unresolved_question: Publish transition matrix and promotion/deprecation propagation in KERNEL-003 or KERNEL-004.

obligations.source_quote: One logical system with versioned contracts.
obligations.interpretation: CONTRACT_VERSION 1.1.0 is shared across records and contracts modules; append-only store is the single kernel persistence surface.

obligations.source_quote: Schemas remain ruthlessly minimal.
obligations.interpretation: Phase 1 dataclasses intentionally omit product fields; additions require obligation row and guard approval.

obligations.source_quote: First implementation is ruthlessly minimal.
obligations.interpretation: Deferred concepts and gap rows document intentional Phase 1 limits; no silent completeness claims.

obligations.source_quote: Dependent records may become stale when commitments change.
obligations.interpretation: Kernel stores commitment links; propagation contract for Shape/Transformation consumers is not yet published.
obligations.unresolved_question: Define staleness signals in KERNEL-005 dependency contract or a parent decision.
